notes.title: Outrider Mako Update Ver. 1.356.7
notes.content:
Thank you all for playing Outrider Mako!

After hearing your feedback and bug reports, we have rolled out a patch which fixes several bugs that were affecting the playability of the game, mainly to the red nectar system.

[b]Bug Fixes / Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Recover full HP when saving at a save point.
[*]All boxes can be opened without red nectar.
[*]Red nectar now dissolves quickly in the rain.
[*]Able to now obtain red nectar when diving into red nectar well. 
[*]Halved the amount of the red nectar needed when synthesizing elixirs.
[*]The prices of the items at the shop will no longer scale depending on quantities purchased.
[*]Increased the overall drop rate of red nectar
[*]Adjusted Mako's defense.
[*]Adjusted enemy movement and boss fight difficulty.
[*]Adjusted so that red nectar is no longer lost when taking damage while pouncing.
[*]Fixed a bug related to Safety Stake.

[/list]
We truly appreciate everyone's support and we hear all of your feedback! We are currently working closely with the developer to try and squash more bugs and implement more QoL features! Stay tuned for more updates!

If you have any feedback or bugs to report, please post them on the forum(s):

notes.title: Outider Mako Development Progress as of December 2020.
notes.content:
Dear fans,

Thank you for your continued support for Outrider Mako.

Originally, the title was planned for a 2020 release but as we explained [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1072400/view/2403181243000620914]here[/url], as this is creator Asamado Games' first time making a game, it is taking longer than expected to adjust all the settings in Game Maker Studio.

Game system wise, the title is currently around 70-80% complete. From now on Asamado will continue developing the remaining 20-30% while also fixing issues that are raised through test playing.

As the focus has been on the game system development up until this point, work still needs to be done from a content perspective. Currently, "the world design and the expression has been evolved to a much higher level from the playable demo at TGS 2019, now I will begin adding more contents while maintaining this level of quality." according to the developer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140568/b9cc43e58c2e83e21ace4888a3c905c32832d540.gif[/img]

The following game system elements have been improved over the demo.

[list]
[*] Shop feature.
[*] Collectible handling and placement.
[*] Player movement.
[*] Player attacks.
[*] The effect of the time of day or weather on the game.
[*] Workbench actions (crafting etc.)
[*] Puzzle solving components.
[*] Dialogue system.
[*] Overall animations and production.
[*] Delivery centre contents.
[*] HUD and UI.
[*] Tutorial.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140568/3f56884aabd58c8bd3a54bf0a0f9ad4d8aa083cf.gif[/img]

A comment from Asamado Games:
[quote=author]
Release has been postponed unfortunately but don't worry, it's not that there are problems with development, that has been progressing.

The issue came with brushing up the game system elements, which took way longer than I was expecting, and therefore has led to a delay in the development shcedule.

I will continue developing at top speed in order to get it to players as soon as possible.
[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140568/f7191a6f220b336be16928b1da59eade322a8d51.gif[/img]

We at PLAYISM have all played the new and improved version and we can guarantee that the quality has come on leaps and bounds since the demo last year, so please look forward to it.

We will continue updating you on development progress through Asamado Games and PLAYISM social channels as before and we are looking forward to the day everybody gets to play Outrider Mako.

Again, thank you for your continued support!

PLAYISM

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140568/0d2743a9578dafcd6afb900f8c982d8a4be54d94.gif[/img]

notes.title: The charm of Outrider Mako, first ever solo project from developer Asamado Games
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=KbZMh3aFcMc;full][/previewyoutube]

Outrider mako is a top down 2D Action game by solo developer Asamado Games.
Mako is roped into working for the Bumon Delivery Corporation in the world of the gods, Mayoi.
She is told that if she continues to complete her assignments and collects enough stamps that she will be able to return to her own world...

Mako has garnered several awards and nominations thus far:
[list]
[*] The Gadget Tsushin Award at BitSummit 7 Spirits.
[*] Nominated for the Dengeki PlayStation Indie Game Category at Tokyo Game Show.
[*] Nominated for the Best Overseas Game Category at Indie Play.
[/list]


The playable character Mako must solve the puzzles around the world map in order to explore new areas and collect the goods she is assigned to deliver.
By delivering goods to the various Gods, you can receive Blessings which will improve your abilities, giving you an edge in combat while exploring.

[h3]Game Features[/h3]

[list]
[*] Japanese style pixel art.
[*] Unique gameplay feel built up over countless cycles of trial and error.
[*] Dynamic combat where you can Pounce on top of your enemies and cover them with pink Slime to hinder their movement. 
[/list]


Believe it or not, it took over a year to get this Pounce mechanic right.
In this demo you can play the first stage of the game.
It is difficult to convey the feeling of this mechanic so please give it a go yourselves in this demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140568/c49305fcce009570b4b343368288635b26472e7f.gif[/img]


[h3]Development background[/h3]

[list]
[*] ・The developer, Asamado Games, used to be a designer.  Everything in the game has been developed solo, apart from the Japanese font.
 This is my first game project as well as my first experience with pixel art.
 It is also my first time using Game maker and I have had to learn everything from scratch. It took me three years from starting the project to being able to show it off for the first time in 2019.

 I was already a middle aged man when I started making this game.
 I didn't really think about if I was too old to start making games or anything like that.
 I just thought to myself suddenly, man I really want to make a game. 

[*] I have put a lot of painstaking hours into making the movement animations smooth and I focused particularly on connecting the movements so they look natural.

[*] My work ethic is based on the concept of gathering resources for a long winter. I enjoy the feeling of working bit by bit on my project, and building up to the final product.
While playing games like Minecraft and the Tomorrow Children, I thought to myself. All I'm doing is digging holes and gathering stuff, but this is really fun.
This made me feel like if I made a game then I would definitely want it to have a collecting aspect to it.

[/list]

The cathartic nature of just collecting stuff + Souls-like grueling combatis what I'm aiming for with this title.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140568/c939605bc3f65644776c6f9e1e8b25803c040d91.gif[/img]


[h3]On Asamado Games[/h3]

Below is a message from Asamado Games.

[list]
[*] I remember as a kid playing Fantasian, Hydlide and Xanadu that I read about in BASIC Magazine on the X1.It inspired me to start making music at a very young age.

[*] I remember completing Dragon Quest 1 on my NES and watching the epic credits, crying for the first time playing games thinking to myself why wasn't I on the staff credit list! I must admit I was a little disappointed.
 
[*] I bought a PS1 but ended up not playing it so much at which point I found myself moving away from games.
Many years later, when I was no longer in my youth, I jumped back into games with the likes of Fallout 4 and Dark Souls on PC.
And it kind of jolted me into thinking, I don't just want to play games, I want to create them.
So it was that I started my sudden journey into the world of game development.
[/list]

I had to get back into mathematics and English so I could learn to program.
As a result it is taking longer than I ever could have imagined to make this, especially as I am doing it solo.
But I have vowed to myself that I will produce something that I find thoroughly satisfying.

--------

You can check Asamado Games' development journal for Outrider Mako on Steam News or:

[url=https://twitter.com/asamado_tw]Twitter[/url]

[url=https://www.outridermako.com/]Blog: [/url]


Please take a look if you are interested in his journey.


Add Outrider Mako to your wishlists and let's cheer him on together!

notes.title: Developer Log 24/03/2020
notes.content:
Dear Fans,
We have some updates on the development of Outrider Mako!

[h2]Wetland Brawl.[/h2]

Outrider Mako will feature a variety of locations such as grassland, rocky areas, forests and wetlands.
This is an example of rainy wetland.

You can see the characters reflected in the puddles.

Apologies for the technical explanation but instead of using a new surface, to avoid increasing graphics on the texture page (which would be a nightmare), we used several layers to achieve this effect.
This allows for simpler processing and less hassle overall.

[previewyoutube=G4qDokHXWlA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Take flight and dive on your enemies.[/h2]

In Mayoi, even humans can fly.

[previewyoutube=VvRtji6BVCg;full][/previewyoutube]

Well, not all the time, you will be able to take to the air under certain conditions and places.

You wil be able to reach areas that were inaccessible and view areas that you've not been to yet.
If you couldn't beat some enemies head on you may fair better attacking from above.

Anyway we are steaming ahead with development. Currently we are focusing on expanding the map.
We will continue to update you on development progress so watch this space!

*As this game is under development, please be aware that the information provided here may change or be removed entirely from the final product.

notes.title: Developer Log 09/10/2019
notes.content:
Dear Fans,

We bring you this developer update on Outrider Mako.
*As this game is under development, please be aware that the information provided here may change or be removed entirely from the final product.

[h1]The Encyclopedia of Divine Blessings[/h1]
This curious book held by Mako is not filled in by Mako herself or by anyone else in particular.
It kind of just magically fills itself in and updates the contents.

The words written within are also not of any language used by humans, however, anybody reading it will find that they can understand what is written as if they were reading their own language.

A strange book indeed which writes itself depending on the actions of the holder. Complete the tasks assigned to you to gradually increase its contents.

[previewyoutube=jBKrbjw0big;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Divine Blessing Stones[/h1]
Upon successful delivery of goods to the clients, they will bestow upon you a divine blessing.

These blessings are held within unsealed Divine Blessing Stones.

You can select a stone to activate the effects of that blessing.

Choose which combinations of blessings to activate before you head out on a job to make your life easier.

Blessing stone instructional video:

[previewyoutube=bwN2Kp-rmiM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Character Introduction: Tsunemori Jogoro[/h1]
Although not a story centric game, there are several recurring characters.

Is he friend or foe?
Is he human...or something else?

Tsunemori Jogoro

Although he goes by a human name, the aura he gives off suggests otherwise.
Who could he be?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140568/0628ad963c7284e9b3d3185c6c9de4cbe279bf1b.png[/img]

Outrider Mako received a nomination for the Dengeki Online Indie Award at Tokyo Game Show this year!

This is the Japanese gameplay guide that was created for TGS. Check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140568/76566540a9e87953f46ed61180e752d5fd442734.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140568/8ba04510d117ff12c57d8cb40e82f4a5794460f5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140568/dbd8f386312ac37ff3e7715d9977f2b87bef7cfa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35140568/da4634073a392a2037a6d51c140879e2ef0376fe.png[/img]

We will strive to improve the gameplay experience further as we continue development.

We also plan to release more developer logs so please look forward to our next update!

notes.content:
Dear all,

Playism will be at PAX WEST from August 29th!
Our booth number is [h1][b]6016[/b][/h1], and we will be exhibibting three games in addition to[i] Pixel Game Maker MV[/i]:

[h1]Deeeer Simulator[/h1]

## For the first time playable, [i]Deeeer Simulator[/i]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35140568/abdda6b883c70d8865a7eb2f56d6812043bd1d9e.gif[/img]
### Your Average Everyday Deer Game

Take on the role of the main character: a deer. Run around town freely taking advantage of the main character’s deer-specific attributes, such as your stretchy neck and your stabby antlers!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2K2mp2ZAA8w

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1018800/DEEEER_Simulator/

## [i]Outrider Mako[/i] and [i]Orangeblood [/i]demos will be available for the first time in English!

[h1]Orangeblood[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/2ac545fc68b70668939dfc9db3d5079c95c24535.gif[/img]

### “WELCOME TO NEW KOZA”

It's the end of the 20th century, on a different timeline. A manmade island off the coast of Okinawa is humming with a dirty, exotic vibe - and it's awesome!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042670/Orangeblood/

[h1]Outrider Mako [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35140568/67d493c28893fbe78792706c0896fbdb02f52fd1.gif[/img]

### Get ready to jump into battle and solve some mysteries!

In accordance with a deal made with the self-proclaimed ""delivery service"" and all-around mysterious entity known as Bumon, Mako has taken a job working as a lackey at the Bumon Delivery Corporation in ""Mayoi - the world of the gods.""

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hl8XX9QevTU

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072400/Outrider_Mako/

[h1]Pixel Game Maker MV[/h1]

Pixel Game Maker MV, which's full release will be this year, will also be exhibited.
You can try the 4-player motorcycle game made with Pixel Game Maker MV and user-created action games!
